guarantees_metadata.page_title: Trust Guarantees & Payment Structure | Thomas Cherickal
guarantees_metadata.description: Risk-free and scam-free training structure: zero money upfront, ten equal installments, walkaway guarantee, and Apache 2.0 commercial license.
guarantees_metadata.hero_desc: How our zero-upfront, ten-installment plan and Apache 2.0 commercial license keep you safe, give you total control, and make every project risk-free.

trust_pillars.title: Strictly Zero Dollars Upfront ($0)
trust_pillars.description: You never pay a single cent before training begins. There are no registration fees, no setup fees, and no advance deposits.

trust_pillars.title: Pay Training in Ten Equal Parts (10% Each)
trust_pillars.description: Your live training investment is divided into ten equal payments of 10% each. You only pay after each training milestone is completed and verified by you.

trust_pillars.title: Zero Charge Training Materials
trust_pillars.description: Zero charge for training materials: All training materials will be provided to the client with an Apache 2.0 license for internal use, commercial use, or even resale with only one requirement - attribution to the original author. The license will not be provided if the training ends early.

trust_pillars.title: Walk Away Free Guarantee
trust_pillars.description: Try the training with zero financial risk. If you are not completely happy after the first phase, you can walk away owing nothing.

trust_pillars.title: Clear Daily Schedule
trust_pillars.description: Training takes place for 4 hours each day, Monday through Friday. Saturdays and Sundays are restful holidays. Every session is delivered 100% online so anyone worldwide can join.

trust_pillars.title: Full Commercial Ownership (Apache 2.0)
trust_pillars.description: Everything created during the training - all written notes, guides, checklists, and code - belongs to you under the open Apache 2.0 license. You can use it inside your business, sell it to clients, or share it however you want.

agency_comparison.our_guarantee: Milestones: You only pay 10% after you inspect and approve completed training blocks. Dedicated support has zero extra charge and is 100% included in the price.
Walk Away Free: Pay $0 if you are not happy after Phase 1.

agency_comparison.our_guarantee: You Own Everything: Apache 2.0 license gives you full commercial rights.

agency_comparison.typical_agency: Same expensive price regardless of your country.
agency_comparison.our_guarantee: Fair Rates: Transparent discounts for 195 countries based on local purchasing power.

apache_license_rights.description: Use all lesson materials, scripts, and prompts in your daily business operations without paying any royalties.
Package, share, or resell the guides, courses, and tools directly to your own clients or customers.
Share all notes and videos freely across your whole company so future team members can learn too.
Build your own products or services on top of what you learned. All that is needed is a simple credit line mentioning the author.
